meta.title: Finoinc — Personal finance that never leaves your Mac
meta.description: Free, open-source personal finance for macOS. Import your bank's OFX statement, categorize it with rules, and keep everything in one SQLite file you own.

hero.title:
Your money.
Your data too.
hero.subtitle: Personal finance that never leaves your Mac.

product.title: Drop in a statement. Read your month.

import.title: Review before anything is saved
import.body: Drag the .ofx in, open it from Finder, or let the app watch a folder. Duplicates are flagged and left unchecked, refunds are paired with their charges, and nothing is written until you say so.
import.alt: The import review, with duplicate rows flagged and a refund paired with its charge

rules.title: Rules that categorize for you
rules.body: If the description contains this, file it under that. Rules run on every import, ship ready for your language, and a category you pick by hand always wins.
rules.alt: The rules list, each rule matching description snippets to a category

suggestions.title: It shows you which rules you're missing
suggestions.body: Finoinc spots recurring charges that landed without a category and pre-fills the rule. You pick the category: the app points at the pattern, it never guesses what it means.
suggestions.alt: Suggested rules for recurring uncategorized charges

dashboard.title: A month you can actually read
dashboard.body: Income, expenses, balance, spending by category and where your income comes from. Transfers between your own accounts never count twice, and investments get their own panel.
dashboard.alt: The dashboard with monthly totals, category donut and eleven months of trend

calendar.title: Bills on a calendar, not in your head
calendar.body: Every rule with a due day becomes a bill. See what's paid, pending and overdue, and settle it against the exact transaction that paid it.
calendar.alt: The bills calendar with paid, pending and overdue bills

flow.title: From your bank's file to clear answers.
flow.body: Your bank already exports OFX. Finoinc takes it from there.
flow.s1_body: The statement file your bank already offers.
flow.s2_body: Duplicates and refunds come pre-flagged. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
flow.s3_body: Charges that match a rule land in their category; the ones that don't, you teach in a click.
flow.s4_body: finan.db, plain SQLite. Back it up, move it, open it anywhere.

privacy.title: Private by design, not by promise.
privacy.table_title: When does it touch the network?
privacy.r1: Launching, importing, categorizing, browsing, backing up
privacy.r2v: Never dials out. It only listens on 127.0.0.1
privacy.r3v: Only the CNPJ digits, to BrasilAPI, after you turn it on
privacy.path_tail: Back it up, copy it anywhere, open it with any SQLite client. It's yours.
privacy.free_body: MIT-licensed and built by its author for their own money. There are no servers to pay for and nothing to sell.

ai.title: Your AI asks. Finoinc answers.
ai.body: Turn on the MCP server and a local AI agent can ask about your money in plain language. The server listens on 127.0.0.1 only and starts off. Read tools start on, write tools start off, and every tool has its own switch.
ai.q: How much did I spend on restaurants last month, and is it going up?
ai.a: R$ 374,93 on restaurants in September, 12% less than August. It has dropped two months in a row.
ai.warning: The server sends nothing anywhere, but the agent you connect does: whatever it reads, it forwards to its own provider. That's your call to make, which is why the server ships off and writing starts off.

specs.title: Small, native, yours.
specs.stack: on the WebKit macOS already ships

install.s1: Download the .dmg and drag Finoinc into Applications.
